Header line 3 adds 'flight timeline spec 2026-10-08'. Do NOT touch GPS_PORT..RX_NODE_ADDRESS, the I2C addresses, the register constants or the LoRa(...) call.

Barometer (D4): init_baro() keeps BMP280(i2c_dev=SMBus(I2C_BUS), i2c_addr=BARO_Address), the same setup(mode='normal', temperature_oversampling=16, pressure_oversampling=16, temperature_standby=62.5), sleep(1) and the discarded first get_pressure(), and now returns chip only (None on failure). New capture_pad_baseline(): if baro is None return None; mean of 10 get_pressure() readings 0.1 s apart, print 'BMP280 pad baseline: {:.2f} hPa', return it; on exception print 'BMP280 pad baseline unavailable: ...' and return None. Module global pad_pressure_hpa = None at import. read_baro() returns (t_c, p_hpa, alt_m, None) when pad_pressure_hpa is None and the full tuple otherwise.

Camera (D5): keep start_camera() as is but do NOT call it at import; set camera = None and video_path = None at module level. Add stop_camera(): global camera; if camera is not None: try stop_recording(), close(), print('Camera recording saved:', video_path) except Exception as e: print('Camera shutdown error:', e); finally camera = None. The finally: block calls stop_camera() (idempotent) and the summary line prints packets sent, failures, sensor errors, final phase name, video path or 'none'.

Phase state machine (section B, D2, D3, D15): module globals phase = 'P', lock_streak = 0, last_lock_sentence = '', t0_mono = None. Implement advance_phase(gps_line) (module-level, uses `global`) that returns t_clock (None in PAD): in PAD, if gps_line != last_lock_sentence (a new GGA sentence) then update last_lock_sentence and parse it with pynmea2.parse inside try/except; int(msg.gps_qual) >= 1 -> lock_streak += 1 else lock_streak = 0 (parse error / empty also resets); if lock_streak >= 3: lock_mono = monotonic(); t0_mono = lock_mono + COUNTDOWN_S; phase = 'C'; log transition; pad_pressure_hpa = capture_pad_baseline(); camera, video_path = start_camera() (print 'Camera recording locally to:' when ok). When t0_mono is set: t_clock = round(monotonic() - t0_mono, 1); if phase == 'C' and t_clock >= 0.0: phase = 'F', log; if phase == 'F' and t_clock >= FLIGHT_DURATION_S: phase = 'R', log, stop_camera(), SAMPLE_PERIOD = RECOVERY_PERIOD_S, next_sample = monotonic(). Transition log format: 'PHASE <FROM> -> <TO>  T<+/-x.x or ---->  gps_utc=<HH:MM:SS or n/a>  <reason>' with reasons 'GPS lock (3 consecutive GGA fixes)', 'T-0', 'avionics window {FLIGHT_DURATION_S:.0f} s elapsed'; gps_utc from pynmea2.parse(gps_line).timestamp guarded. Transitions are forward only and GPS is never consulted again after lock.

Main loop: SAMPLE_PERIOD becomes a module global (still 1.0 / SAMPLE_RATE_HZ initially) so advance_phase can change it; replace `while (monotonic() - start_time) < FLIGHT_DURATION_S:` with `while True:`; pass order: GPS_strg = poll_gps(); t_clock = advance_phase(GPS_strg); then `if phase != 'R':` around the IMU block, the magnetometer block and the read_baro() call (in RECOVERY ints stay 0 and baro_t/p/alt/agl are None so the fields are empty); build the packet as ints + ',' + baro + ',' + phase + ',' + ('' if t_clock is None else '{:.1f}'.format(t_clock)) + ',' + GPS_strg and update the layout comment (0-9 ints, 10-13 baro, 14 phase, 15 t_clock, 16.. GGA); lora.send stays guarded. Status line: append 'phase=PAD(waiting for GPS lock)' in PAD, otherwise 'phase=<NAME> T<+/-x.x>'; keep the rest of the line. Keep the deadline scheduler code; note in the comment that RECOVERY lowers the period to 1 s.

TX DESIGN AS BUILT: constants COUNTDOWN_S = 30.0, RECOVERY_PERIOD_S = 1.0, PHASE_NAMES; header line 3 ends with ', flight timeline spec 2026-10-08'. Module globals phase='P', lock_streak=0, last_lock_sentence='', t0_mono=None, pad_pressure_hpa=None, camera=None, video_path=None, SAMPLE_RATE_HZ=10, SAMPLE_PERIOD=0.1, next_sample. init_baro() returns chip or None; capture_pad_baseline() (10 x get_pressure 0.1 s apart) is called in the PAD->COUNTDOWN transition; read_baro() returns agl None while pad_pressure_hpa is None. start_camera() unchanged but called only at lock; stop_camera() idempotent, called at FLIGHT->RECOVERY and from finally:. advance_phase(gps_line) does lock counting (new GGA string only; parse error/empty/qual 0 resets streak) and the time-based transitions; t_clock = round(monotonic() - t0_mono, 1) + 0.0 (the + 0.0 normalises -0.0 so the wire never carries '-0.0'; the harness found this). Loop: while True; pass order poll_gps -> advance_phase -> IMU (if imu_ok and phase != 'R') -> mag (if mag_ok and phase != 'R') -> read_baro (if phase != 'R') -> packet -> guarded lora.send -> status line -> deadline sleep. RECOVERY sets SAMPLE_PERIOD = 1.0 and next_sample = monotonic().

PACKET: ints(10) + ',' + baro(4 x '%.2f' or '') + ',' + phase + ',' + ('' if t_clock is None else '%.1f') + ',' + GGA. PAD: field 13 empty, field 15 empty. RECOVERY: ints all '0', fields 10-13 empty, GGA kept.

TRANSITION LOG FORMAT (exact, one print per transition, stdout -> journal): 'PHASE <FROM> -> <TO>  T<+/-x.x>  gps_utc=<HH:MM:SS|n/a>  <reason>' with two spaces between groups. Examples from the harness: 'PHASE PAD -> COUNTDOWN  T-30.0  gps_utc=14:57:05  GPS lock (3 consecutive GGA fixes)', 'PHASE COUNTDOWN -> FLIGHT  T+0.0  gps_utc=14:57:34  T-0', 'PHASE FLIGHT -> RECOVERY  T+5.0  gps_utc=14:57:39  avionics window 5 s elapsed' (480 s in flight). gps_utc comes from pynmea2.parse(gps_line).timestamp, 'n/a' if the line is empty/unparseable. Other new prints: 'BMP280 pad baseline: 1011.73 hPa' (at lock), 'BMP280 pad baseline unavailable: ...', 'Camera recording locally to: <path>' (at lock), 'Camera recording saved: <path>' (at RECOVERY or stop).

STATUS LINE FORMAT (once per second): 't={:5.0f}s  pkts={:<6d}  rate={:.1f} Hz (target 10 Hz)  gps=<nofix|fix sats=N|bad>  baro=<1011.7hPa agl=+0.0m | 1011.7hPa agl=n/a | n/a>  i2c_err=N  tx_fail=N  phase=<PAD(waiting for GPS lock) | COUNTDOWN T-12.3 | FLIGHT T+37.0 | RECOVERY T+483.7>'. The 'agl=n/a' variant is new: in PAD agl is None and the old '{:+.1f}' would have raised TypeError inside the loop. Summary line in finally: 'TX done: N packets sent, N send failures, N sensor errors, phase: <NAME>, video: <path|none>'.

SERVICE: Restart=on-failure, RestartSec=5, ExecStartPre=/bin/sleep 10, venv ExecStart, WorkingDirectory, After=local-fs.target, Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1, Environment=TX_FLIGHT_DURATION_S=480 (comment: avionics window from T-0, T-0 = 30 s after lock, GPS-only 1 Hz afterwards until power off), journal lines, WantedBy=multi-user.target.
